newsitem.title: USA: The Leap Group to acquire Asia ad group.
newsitem.headline: The Leap Group to acquire Asia ad group.

text.p: The Leap Group Inc said Thursday it signed a non-binding letter of intent to purchase certain assets of privately-held Kang & Lee Advertising Inc in New York and its Los Angeles, Calif. based operation, K&L West Advertising Inc.
Kang & Lee and K&L, a U.S.-based Asian advertising group, was formed in 1985 and has a staff of about 70. The company develops marketing campaigns targeting Asian-American markets.

"Kang & Lee's expertise within the various markets involving Asian consumers will allow Leap to offer expanded global marketing resources to large consumer brands in the United States and around the world," said R. Steven Lutterbach, chairman and chief executive officer, in a news release.
The Leap Group provides consumer marketing, advertising, multimedia and Internet-related services and products.
